Key points
• The nutritive value of proteins depends both on the amount of protein provided, on the amino acid composition and
concentration, and on the bioavailability of nitrogen and amino acids.
• Protein quality is assessed in humans by measuring nitrogen balance, by biological assay in animal models, or from amino
acids using the amino acid scoring corrected by the digestibility.
